definitions.explanation: Describes procedures, processes, or systems that are troublesome because they involve many tedious or intricate steps. Often used for bureaucratic or administrative matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煩雑|はんざつ}だ。
{煩雑|はんざつ}な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煩雑|はんざつ}で、⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This system is cumbersome and has room for improvement.

notes:
{煩雑|はんざつ} describes things that are annoyingly complicated or involve many tedious steps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煩雑|はんざつ}な⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (complicated procedures)
- {煩雑|はんざつ}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (tedious work)
- {煩雑|はんざつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (avoid complexity)

CONJUGATION:
- {煩雑|はんざつ}な + noun (attributive)
- {煩雑|はんざつ}だ (predicative)
- {煩雑|はんざつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧ - complex (neutral; can be positive)
- {煩雑|はんざつ} - complicated (negative; implies annoyance)
